messages:
Asha: Quick sync — launch posts + webinar checklist around SEO. Need to close schema, internal links, redirects, and keyword mapping before Thursday EOD. Can we split tasks? :calendar:
Liam: I'm happy to own keyword mapping and headline SEO for launch posts. I'll update the heatmap sheet by noon. Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/placeholder-kw-heatmap
Sylvia: I'll take schema (Article/FAQ/LD+JSON). Question: do we need structured data for webinar recordings too?
Asha: Yes — recordings should have VideoObject + transcript if feasible. Also add og:video and og:duration tags.
Ravi: I'll audit current internal links on the pillar page and post a short redirect map. Any canonical overrides for gated content?
Sylvia: For gated pieces, canonical should point to the public summary page, not the gated URL. We'll add rel=canonical and meta robots: noindex on gated pages where necessary.
seo-bot: [crawl-alert] Found 12 redirect chains on /blog/launch that could leak link equity — see report: https://seo.internal/reports/3843
Liam: Can we prioritise fixing the 3 highest-traffic redirects first? I can patch copy on the launch posts after redirects are set. :+1:
Ravi: Agreed. I'll add redirect rules to the tracker. Example rules to hand off to infra:
```
# nginx redirect rules (draft)
rewrite ^/old-launch-asset$ /launch-2026 permanent;
rewrite ^/webinar-signup-old$ /webinar/register permanent;
rewrite ^/rd/late-cta$ /signup?src=launch permanent;
```
Sylvia: Also adding schema snippets for FAQ and VideoObject. Draft FAQ JSON-LD below:
```json
{"@context": "https://schema.org",
 "@type": "FAQPage",
 "mainEntity": [
   {"@type": "Question",
    "name": "How do I join the webinar?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {"@type": "Answer", "text": "Register via /webinar/register and you'll get a calendar invite."}
   }
 ]
}
```
Asha: Good. Can we add internal links from the webinar landing to 2 related product pages and the main docs? Use follow links, avoid nofollow. Anchor text should be descriptive (not just "click here").
Liam: I'll add anchor text variations in the posts and create a 3-link plan: product overview, pricing, docs/quickstart. Will update the sheet with exact anchors.
Ravi: I'll also run a site-wide anchor audit and push a PR against the content repo with fixes by EOD. If I find >5 chains I'll raise an infra ticket.
Asha: Who's on QA for schema + redirects?
Sylvia: Me for schema (I will run Rich Results test + internal validator).
Ravi: Me for redirects and link QA; I'll run a staging crawl once rules are applied.
Liam: I'll validate content changes and confirm metadata (title/meta description) match the keyword intent.
Asha: Awesome. I'll consolidate into a checklist and post an update at 16:30. Assigning cards: @Liam -> KW + post copy, @Sylvia -> schema + FAQ JSON-LD, @Ravi -> redirects + anchor audit. :white_check_mark:
Liam: On it.
Ravi: Starting the redirect map now. Ping me if you see urgent broken links (esp. /pricing and /docs).
seo-bot: [scan-complete] Next crawl scheduled in 6h. Will flag any new chains and report mobile crawl status.
Asha: Thanks team — this should keep launch gating clean. Please update the sheet and the tracker when you're done.
